name: github-pr-monitor
title: GitHub PR Monitor
description: Browse your open GitHub PRs and review requests using the gh CLI.
author: sujha

commands.name: list-prs
commands.title: List GitHub PRs
commands.subtitle: GitHub PR Monitor
commands.description: Show your open PRs and review requests for a repository.

preferences.name: repo
preferences.title: Include Repositories
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of repos to include, in owner/name format (e.g. acme/api,acme/web). Supports wildcards: owner/* matches every repo under an owner, and * matches everything. Leave blank to search across all repos you can access.

preferences.name: excludeRepo
preferences.title: Exclude Repositories
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of repos to exclude, in owner/name format. Supports wildcards: owner/* excludes every repo under an owner. Applied after Include Repositories.

preferences.name: accounts
preferences.title: GitHub Accounts
preferences.description: Which gh CLI accounts to fetch PRs from. 'Active only' is fastest; 'All' fans out across every logged-in account in ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml.

preferences.name: ghPath
preferences.title: gh CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to the gh executable. Leave empty for auto-detection.

preferences.name: claudePath
preferences.title: Claude CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to the claude executable used for PR reviews. Leave empty to resolve from PATH.

preferences.name: reviewScript
preferences.title: PR Review Script
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to a shell script that performs the PR review. Receives the PR URL as $1 and the env vars PR_URL, PR_NUMBER, PR_REPO, PR_TITLE, PR_AUTHOR, PR_HOST, PR_ACCOUNT. If set, overrides the built-in claude invocation.

preferences.name: reviewPrompt
preferences.title: Claude Review Prompt
preferences.description: Prompt passed to `claude -p` when no review script is set. Use {URL} as a placeholder for the PR URL.
preferences.placeholder: Review pull request {URL} and list findings, risks, and suggestions.
